a.text: He was appointed to UCL and the Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis was set up.

b.text: He was Professor of Spatial Analysis and Planning holding a joint appointment between the Department of Geography and the Bartlett School of Planning at UCL.

a.text: He was elected a Fellow of the British Academy.

b.text: He was elected a Fellow of Academy of Social Sciences.

a.text: He was a Member of the SERC Transport Committee.

b.text: He became Vice-Chair of the ESRC Environment and Planning Committee.
